name: buildctl_help
stdout:
NAME:
   buildctl - build utility

USAGE:
   buildctl [global options] [command [command options]]

VERSION:
   v0.33.1

COMMANDS:
   du               disk usage
   prune            clean up build cache
   prune-histories  clean up build histories
   build, b         build
   debug            debug utilities
   help, h          Shows a list of commands or help for one command

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --debug                 enable debug output in logs
   --addr string           buildkitd address (default: "unix:///run/buildkit/buildkitd.sock")
   --log-format string     log formatter: json or text (default: "text")
   --tlsservername string  buildkitd server name for certificate validation
   --tlscacert string      CA certificate for validation
   --tlscert string        client certificate
   --tlskey string         client key
   --tlsdir string         directory containing CA certificate, client certificate, and client key. Supported file names are (ca.pem, cert.pem, key.pem) or (ca.crt, tls.crt, tls.key)
   --timeout int           timeout backend connection after value seconds (default: 5)
   --wait                  block RPCs until the connection becomes available
   --help, -h              show help
   --version, -v           print the version

name: buildctl_build_help
stdout:
NAME:
   buildctl build - build

USAGE:
   
     To build and push an image using Dockerfile:
       $ buildctl build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --opt target=foo --opt build-arg:foo=bar --local context=. --local dockerfile=. --output type=image,name=docker.io/username/image,push=true
     

OPTIONS:
   --output string, -o string [ --output string, -o string ]                Define exports for build result, e.g. --output type=image,name=docker.io/username/image,push=true
   --progress string                                                        Set type of progress (auto, plain, tty, rawjson). Use plain to show container output (default: "auto")
   --trace string                                                           Path to trace file. Defaults to no tracing.
   --local string [ --local string ]                                        Allow build access to the local directory
   --oci-layout string [ --oci-layout string ]                              Allow build access to the local OCI layout
   --frontend string                                                        Define frontend used for build
   --opt string [ --opt string ]                                            Define custom options for frontend, e.g. --opt target=foo --opt build-arg:foo=bar
   --no-cache                                                               Disable cache for all the vertices
   --export-cache string [ --export-cache string ]                          Export build cache, e.g. --export-cache type=registry,ref=example.com/foo/bar, or --export-cache type=local,dest=path/to/dir
   --import-cache string [ --import-cache string ]                          Import build cache, e.g. --import-cache type=registry,ref=example.com/foo/bar, or --import-cache type=local,src=path/to/dir
   --secret string [ --secret string ]                                      Secret value exposed to the build. Format id=secretname,src=filepath
   --allow string [ --allow string ]                                        Allow extra privileged entitlement, e.g. network.host, security.insecure, device
   --ssh string [ --ssh string ]                                            Allow forwarding SSH agent or a raw Unix socket to the builder. Format default|<id>[=<socket>[,raw=false]|<key>[,<key>]]
   --metadata-file string                                                   Output build metadata (e.g., image digest) to a file as JSON
   --source-policy-file string                                              Read source policy file from a JSON file
   --proxy-network                                                          Run build with proxy network enforcement
   --ref-file string                                                        Write build ref to a file
   --registry-auth-tlscontext string [ --registry-auth-tlscontext string ]  Overwrite TLS configuration when authenticating with registries, e.g. --registry-auth-tlscontext host=https://myserver:2376,insecure=false,ca=/path/to/my/ca.crt,cert=/path/to/my/cert.crt,key=/path/to/my/key.crt
   --debug-json-cache-metrics string                                        Where to output json cache metrics, use 'stdout' or 'stderr' for standard (error) output.
   --help, -h                                                               show help

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --debug                 enable debug output in logs
   --addr string           buildkitd address (default: "unix:///run/buildkit/buildkitd.sock")
   --log-format string     log formatter: json or text (default: "text")
   --tlsservername string  buildkitd server name for certificate validation
   --tlscacert string      CA certificate for validation
   --tlscert string        client certificate
   --tlskey string         client key
   --tlsdir string         directory containing CA certificate, client certificate, and client key. Supported file names are (ca.pem, cert.pem, key.pem) or (ca.crt, tls.crt, tls.key)
   --timeout int           timeout backend connection after value seconds (default: 5)
   --wait                  block RPCs until the connection becomes available

name: buildkitd_help
stdout:
NAME:
   buildkitd - build daemon

USAGE:
   buildkitd [global options]

VERSION:
   v0.33.1

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --rootless                                                                   set all the default options to be compatible with rootless containers
   --config string                                                              path to config file (default: "/etc/buildkit/buildkitd.toml")
   --debug                                                                      enable debug output in logs
   --root string                                                                path to state directory (default: "/var/lib/buildkit")
   --addr string [ --addr string ]                                              listening address (socket or tcp) (default: "unix:///run/buildkit/buildkitd.sock")
   --log-format string                                                          log formatter: json or text (default: "text")
   --log-level string                                                           set the log level (default: "info") [$BUILDKITD_LOG_LEVEL]
   --group string                                                               group (name or gid) which will own all Unix socket listening addresses
   --debugaddr string                                                           debugging address (eg. 0.0.0.0:6060) [$BUILDKITD_DEBUGADDR]
   --tlscert string                                                             certificate file to use
   --tlskey string                                                              key file to use
   --tlscacert string                                                           ca certificate to verify clients
   --allow-insecure-entitlement string [ --allow-insecure-entitlement string ]  allows insecure entitlements e.g. network.host, security.insecure, device
   --proxy-network                                                              enable proxy network enforcement for all builds
   --otel-socket-path string                                                    OTEL collector trace socket path
   --cdi-disabled                                                               disables support of the Container Device Interface (CDI)
   --cdi-spec-dir string [ --cdi-spec-dir string ]                              list of directories to scan for CDI spec files
   --save-cache-debug                                                           enable saving cache debug info
   --containerd-worker string                                                   enable containerd workers (true/false/auto) (default: "auto")
   --containerd-worker-addr string                                              containerd socket (default: "/run/containerd/containerd.sock")
   --containerd-worker-labels string [ --containerd-worker-labels string ]      user-specific annotation labels (com.example.foo=bar)
   --containerd-worker-net string                                               worker network type (auto, bridge, cni or host) (default: "auto")
   --containerd-cni-config-path string                                          path of cni config file (default: "/etc/buildkit/cni.json")
   --containerd-cni-binary-dir string                                           path of cni binary files (default: "/opt/cni/bin")
   --containerd-cni-pool-size int                                               size of cni network namespace pool (default: 0)
   --containerd-worker-snapshotter string                                       snapshotter name to use (default: "overlayfs")
   --containerd-worker-apparmor-profile string                                  set the name of the apparmor profile applied to containers
   --containerd-worker-selinux                                                  apply SELinux labels
   --containerd-max-parallelism int                                             limit the number of parallel build steps that can run at the same time (default: 0)
   --containerd-worker-rootless                                                 enable rootless mode
   --containerd-worker-gc                                                       Enable automatic garbage collection on worker
   --containerd-worker-gc-keepstorage string                                    Amount of storage GC keep locally, format "Reserved[,Free[,Maximum]]" (MB) (default: "10000,91000,100000")
   --oci-worker string                                                          enable oci workers (true/false/auto) (default: "auto")
   --oci-worker-labels string [ --oci-worker-labels string ]                    user-specific annotation labels (com.example.foo=bar)
   --oci-worker-snapshotter string                                              name of snapshotter (overlayfs, native, etc.) (default: "auto")
   --oci-worker-proxy-snapshotter-path string                                   address of proxy snapshotter socket (do not include 'unix://' prefix)
   --oci-worker-platform string [ --oci-worker-platform string ]                override supported platforms for worker
   --oci-worker-net string                                                      worker network type (auto, bridge, cni or host) (default: "auto")
   --oci-cni-config-path string                                                 path of cni config file (default: "/etc/buildkit/cni.json")
   --oci-cni-binary-dir string                                                  path of cni binary files (default: "/opt/cni/bin")
   --oci-cni-pool-size int                                                      size of cni network namespace pool (default: 0)
   --oci-worker-binary string                                                   name of specified oci worker binary
   --oci-worker-apparmor-profile string                                         set the name of the apparmor profile applied to containers
   --oci-worker-selinux                                                         apply SELinux labels
   --oci-max-parallelism int                                                    limit the number of parallel build steps that can run at the same time (default: 0)
   --oci-worker-rootless                                                        enable rootless mode
   --oci-worker-no-process-sandbox                                              use the host PID namespace and procfs (WARNING: allows build containers to kill (and potentially ptrace) an arbitrary process in the host namespace)
   --oci-worker-gc                                                              Enable automatic garbage collection on worker
   --oci-worker-gc-keepstorage string                                           Amount of storage GC keep locally, format "Reserved[,Free[,Maximum]]" (MB) (default: "10000,91000,100000")
